paper.title: Evo-MedAgent: Beyond One-Shot Diagnosis with Agents That Remember, Reflect, and Improve
paper.central_claim: 无需训练的自进化测试时记忆（情景库+程序性启发式库+工具可靠性控制器）让冻结的胸片工具增强智能体跨病例累积经验；在ChestAgentBench上MCQ准确率GPT-5-mini 0.68->0.79、Gemini-3 Flash 0.76->0.87，且对定性诊断任务比编排外部工具提升更大。

claims.text: 自进化记忆使MCQ与开放题准确率显著提升
claims.baseline_control: 同一骨干无记忆基线（tool-free）；全记忆有3次顺序重复，其余单次
claims.selection_vs_test: 记忆在同一评测流内构建，逐案先作答后更新；无冻结记忆的留出集
counterevidence: 同病例多题、真值反馈、仅episodic已近全记忆
claims.allowed_conclusion: 在该基准的顺序流上，开启记忆的在线准确率高于无记忆基线；增益是否可迁移到未见病例/真实监督未知。

assessment.evidence_level_note: Retained, scoped. Memory written from earlier cases is read on later ones, and same-backbone store-off and single-store arms isolate the stores (r04b/r10b/r11b convention: held-out preferred, not required). The weak points are scored in E.holdout = 1: the store is built from the evaluated stream with ground-truth feedback, and sibling questions of the same case may leak. Unlike r02a 2411.13941, a same-actor store-off arm exists.

G.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. Isolated per-case solving is a real limitation. The three-store factorisation and utility selection come from Evo-Memory and ReMe, and no neighbour is compared on this benchmark. The residual is mainly the application domain.

M.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. Precedent retrieval plus outcome-grounded rule edits fits recurrent mistakes. Rule edits are unvalidated, governance is untested, and the 'memory beats tools' reasoning rests on a confounded comparison.

X.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. The read/write cycle and governance thresholds are given. K, K_S, s_epi, the utility formula and the reflection prompt are missing, and there is no forgetting, merging, versioning or admission check.

E.measurement.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. MCQ accuracy on an expert-curated public benchmark is reliable. The open-ended scorer is unspecified, the evaluated N is unstated, and incomplete runs are unexplained (opus:O03).

E.causality.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. Same-backbone store-off and episodic-only / procedural-only arms isolate memory as a whole. Missing: comparison with the cited nearest neighbours (Evo-Memory, Dynamic Cheatsheet, ReMe), a governance or utility ablation, and a budget-matched reflection-only arm. The rule-store increment is within noise (opus:O01). The 'memory beats tools' comparison is memory vs no memory (tool-free = tool-enabled = 0.68).

E.holdout.reason: Both seats 1; re-checked. The construction stream is the evaluation stream, with ground-truth feedback after every item. There is no frozen-store test and no case-level isolation audit (2,500 questions over 675 cases).

E.statistics.reason: Shared correction 2 → 1 (A2 ladder). The only uncertainty is a three-permutation range for one configuration (GPT-5-mini full memory, 0.76–0.82). The evaluated N is never stated, so accuracies cannot become counts or intervals (opus:O02). 'Incomplete runs' carry no failure accounting (opus:O03). The 'consistently outperforms' claim sits inside that range (opus:O01). Tier 2 needs a usable denominator; here the denominator itself is missing.

E.cost.reason: Both seats 1; re-checked. The marginal call budget is explicit (one extra retrieval and one multimodal reflection call per case), so a reader can bound the call ratio. No tokens, latency, memory size or matched-budget arm are given.
